exposure: elective caesarean section before 39 weeks' gestation
cohort: Infants born by elective caesarean section in Western Australia
finding: A reduction in the proportion of elective caesarean sections before 39 weeks in Western Australia was associated with a reduction in retrieval for respiratory compromise related to surfactant deficiency in infants born by elective caesarean section.
mod_finding: Delaying elective cesarean section until 39 weeks' gestation reduced the need for neonatal retrieval for respiratory compromise.
